_comment: Ground truth for retrieval evaluation. Each question maps to the PDF page numbers (1-based) that actually contain the answer in data/ACI_318-19.pdf.pdf. Pages were verified by locating the defining code section in the PDF (e.g. concrete cover = section 20.5.1.3, columns reinforcement ratio = R10.6). Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Used by 08_evaluation.py.
